item.title: Emerald Beach — Guide
item.description: Emerald Beach is a lovely, immaculately maintained public beach within Ocean Expo Park on the Motobu Peninsula in northern Okinawa, right beside the famous Churaumi Aquarium. True to its name, it fronts clear emerald and turquoise water, with soft white sand divided into distinct areas for swimming, playing and relaxing. Because it’s a park beach, it’s exceptionally clean, safe and well-equipped, with lifeguards during the season, showers, rest areas and a calm, netted swimming zone — making it ideal for families and less confident swimmers.

item.title: Ocean Expo Park — Guide
item.description: Ocean Expo Park (Ocean Expo Commemorative National Government Park), on the Motobu Peninsula in northern Okinawa, is a vast seaside park built for the 1975 International Ocean Exposition and one of the island’s top family destinations. While its most famous attraction is the world-class Churaumi Aquarium, the park offers far more across its expansive, beautifully landscaped grounds. Highlights include free dolphin shows at the Okichan Theater, the Dolphin Lagoon, a Manatee and Sea Turtle pool, the Tropical Dream Center with orchids and greenhouses, the Oceanic Culture Museum and planetarium, the reconstructed Okinawan village of Omoro Arboretum, and the lovely Emerald Beach for swimming.

item.title: Churaumi Aquarium Guide: Tickets, Whale Sharks & Access
item.description: The Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium on the Motobu Peninsula is one of the largest and most spectacular aquariums in the world, and northern Okinawa’s headline attraction. Its centrepiece is the colossal “Kuroshio Sea” tank, where enormous whale sharks and graceful manta rays glide behind one of the planet’s biggest acrylic viewing panels. Set within the seaside Ocean Expo Park, it’s a must-visit for families and anyone heading north, easily combined with beaches, dolphin shows and gardens.
